meta_description: AKA Plumbing, Heating & Drainage serve Newcastle and the North East with fast, reliable plumbing and heating solutions. Call today for a free, no-obligation quote.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted North East Plumbers — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler breakdowns, and blocked drains sorted fast — AKA Plumbing is on hand when you need us most.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing, Heating & Drainage Services Across Newcastle & the North East
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and boiler installations to full drainage clearance, AKA Plumbing covers every aspect of your home's plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, or water damage — we respond fast across Newcastle and the wider North East to protect your home and minimise disruption.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing
services.desc: We supply and install energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers, and carry out annual servicing to keep your heating running safely all year round.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: From full system installations to power flushing and radiator repairs, we improve efficiency and restore warmth to your home quickly and affordably.

services.title: Drainage & Drain Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked or slow-draining sinks, toilets, and drains cleared promptly using professional equipment, with no mess left behind once the job is done.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fit-outs and wet room installations carried out to a high standard — we manage all plumbing work from start to finish so you don't have to.

services.title: General Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, leaking joints, faulty stopcocks, and pipe repairs handled efficiently by experienced local tradespeople at competitive, transparent prices.

about_pullquote: We treat every customer's home with the same care as our own.
about_para_1: AKA Plumbing, Heating & Drainage was established to bring honest, high-quality plumbing and heating services to homeowners and businesses across Newcastle and the North East. Built on a foundation of hard work and local knowledge, we've grown steadily by putting our customers first on every single job.
about_para_2: Our team takes pride in turning up on time, keeping you informed throughout, and leaving your property clean and tidy. We don't cut corners, and we don't hit you with hidden charges — just straightforward, reliable work you can depend on. That's why so many of our customers come back to us time and again.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About AKA Plumbing

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Had a leak under the kitchen sink on a Friday afternoon and AKA were with us within a couple of hours. Sorted quickly, no fuss, and the price was very fair. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used AKA to replace our old boiler and couldn't be happier. They talked us through all the options, gave us a clear quote with no hidden costs, and completed the install in a day. Heating is working perfectly now.
reviews.author: Mark R.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the professionalism. Came to clear a badly blocked drain — turned up on time, got straight to work, and left everything spotless. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Louise H.
